text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah... A novel a classmate recommended to me was really interesting.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I only meant to read a little bit at a time,
but before I knew it, morning had come...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume reincarnated as the princess of a great empire...
I wonder what's going to happen next...?

Looking somewhat dazed,
Fine Motion walked away.
